messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — PR #2897 blocked by merge-gate: format check failing on a generated proto file. CI output points to a linewrap complaint in gen/proto/foo.pb.go. Anyone able to approve or suggest a tiny fix?

ci-bot: buildkite: format-check failed — job https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/9876 (gofumpt): `gofumpt` reported diffs in gen/proto/foo.pb.go

sophia: I can take a look. Generated files should be excluded from gofumpt. We either add the generated header or tweak our format script to skip `gen/`.

jamal: I think adding the standard generated comment at top of the file is fine, but we should NOT run gofumpt on gen/ at all. Proposed quick change:

```
# scripts/format.sh (excerpt)
# run gofumpt on all go files except generated
gofumpt $(git ls-files '*.go' ':!gen/**') -w
```

I'll open a tiny PR to add the exclusion and add the header to the one file.

linda: @jamal yeah please do a small PR against release/v1 and then cherrypick to main. Need one approval from @sophia before merging to release branch.

sophia: sounds good — will review once PR is up. small nit: prefer explicit `:!gen/**` over glob hacks. :thumbsup:

alex: I'll leave merge blocked until CI is green. Jamal ping me when ready and I'll merge.

jamal: pushed branch `fix/format-ignore-gen-4125` and opened PR https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2901 — changes: exclude gen/ in scripts/format.sh, add `// Code generated by protoc-gen-go. DO NOT EDIT.` to gen/proto/foo.pb.go, and note in CONTRIBUTING.md

ci-bot: buildkite: format-check passed for PR 2901 — https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/9901

sophia: approved. ✅

linda: merged release/v1 <- PR 2901 and cherrypicked to main. Thanks y'all.

alex: thanks — gate cleared, merging now.
